cases.d: Verify the email webhook returns 503 when no webhook secret is configured.
Verify an unsigned webhook request returns 401 without needing a sign-in.
Verify the raw body and the svix headers reach the receiver unchanged.
steps: POST /api/email/resend/webhook with Content-Type: application/json, headers svix-id: msg_1, svix-timestamp: 1793088000, svix-signature: v1,<valid signature> and body { "type" : "email.delivered" }.
Repeat with an event type the system ignores, then with a malformed event.
exp: A recorded event returns HTTP 200 and the email is marked delivered.
An ignored event returns HTTP 200 and changes nothing.
The body is passed on byte for byte (spaces kept).
pre: The webhook secret is set and a sent email exists.

cases.d: Verify a receiver error returns 500 so Resend retries.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, so the provider sends it again later.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/health answers ok with the service name.
Verify /api/health still answers JSON when the frontend is built into the backend.
steps: Build the frontend (npm run build) and start the backend.
pre: The frontend has been built into wwwroot.

cases.d: Verify unknown API and hub paths return 404, not the web page.
steps: With the frontend built, GET /api/duong-dan-khong-ton-tai, /api/users/notaguid and /hubs/khong-ton-tai.
exp: None returns the HTML of the web application.
pre: The frontend has been built into wwwroot.

cases.d: Verify a real API route is not hidden by the web page fallback.
exp: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (the API answers, not the web page).
pre: The frontend has been built into wwwroot.

cases.d: Verify a page route of the web application still serves index.html.
steps: With the frontend built, open http://localhost:5225/meetings in the browser.
exp: HTTP 200 OK and the TrustCabinet web application loads.
pre: The frontend has been built into wwwroot.

cases.d: Verify notifications and their realtime hub require a valid sign-in.
Verify the list, mark-all-read and target check only touch the signed-in user's notifications.
steps: GET the target of the other user's notification.
exp: The list contains only "Thông báo của tôi".
The other user's notification is not found (HTTP 404).
pre: thuky has the notification "Thông báo của tôi"; thanhvien has "Thông báo người khác".

cases.d: Verify a deactivated account cannot read notifications even with a valid token.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of an account that has since been deactivated>

pre: The account signed in, kept its token and was then deactivated.

cases.d: Verify the notification list returns MSG40 with 500 when the account check fails.
exp: HTTP 500 with code "MSG40" ("Không thể tải thông báo. Vui lòng thử lại.").
pre: The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify the backend can run without the background notification worker (test configuration).
steps: Start the backend with the notification worker disabled.
exp: No reminder is created in the background while the worker is off.
pre: Backend configuration that disables the notification worker.
